name: declare_and_instantiate
source: class Box {} var b=Box(); b.value=7; print b.value;

name: field_update
source: class Box {} var b=Box(); b.value=1; b.value=2; print b.value;

name: instances_have_separate_fields
source: class Box {} var a=Box(); var b=Box(); a.x=1; b.x=2; print a.x; print b.x;

name: method_call
source: class Greeter { greet() { return "hello"; } } print Greeter().greet();

name: initializer_and_this
source: class Box { init(value) { this.value=value; } get() { return this.value; } } print Box(7).get();

name: method_mutates_this
source: class Counter { init() { this.n=0; } inc() { this.n=this.n+1; return this.n; } } var c=Counter(); print c.inc(); print c.inc();

name: bound_method_retains_receiver
source: class Box { init(x) { this.x=x; } get() { return this.x; } } var b=Box(9); var getter=b.get; print getter();
requirement: Detached method stays bound to its receiver

name: initializer_empty_return
source: class Box { init() { this.x=3; return; } } print Box().x;
requirement: Empty initializer return still constructs the instance
